audit_dashboard_metrics existe y es una vista
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='audit_dashboard_metrics' AND c.relkind='v'
"total": 1
audit_dashboard_metrics expone 34 columnas (32 previas + created_by + is_test)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped
"total": 34
audit_dashboard_metrics proyecta created_by e is_test
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped AND attname IN ('created_by','is_test')
"total": 2
is_test es la ultima columna de audit_dashboard_metrics
SELECT a.attname AS last_col FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum DESC LIMIT 1
"last_col": "is_test"
las 7 dimensiones del caso siguen proyectadas en audit_dashboard_metrics

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped AND attname IN ('country','channel','campus','modality','project','responsible','guideline')
"total": 7

ninguna vista de dashboard es accesible por anon/authenticated

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid IN ('public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass, 'public.case_comparisons_dashboard_metrics'::regclass) AND g.grantee IN ((SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='anon'), (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='authenticated'))
"total": 0
project_admin tiene SELECT en ambas vistas de dashboard

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid IN ('public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass, 'public.case_comparisons_dashboard_metrics'::regclass) AND g.grantee='project_admin'::regrole AND g.privilege_type='SELECT'
